title: BrowserControlledData
description: data of browser.controlled (registry 1.7.0, ADR-0051, BR-10): the world owner paused, resumed, stopped or took over a browser session from the Browser panel. actor is that person, target the Browser Station building, authz null (control never authorises a side effect; it only holds or ends one). The panel shows Paused only after this event (HR-1). stop and take_over are followed by browser.stopped.

step.description: The last step recorded when the op took effect.
